page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused instance from the ecs.d1 family, featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It includes 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The defining feature of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, which includes 70,866 GB of bundled local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is integrated directly with the instance, making it suitable for sequential read and write operations. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth, utilizing the KVM hypervisor for virtualization.

Given the massive HDD storage capacity and dedicated Intel Xeon processors, this instance is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive data storage capacity without the premium cost of SSDs. It is well-suited for large-scale data warehousing, log processing, MapReduce jobs, and distributed file systems like HDFS where sequential storage throughput and capacity are prioritized over random IOPS.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is a storage-focused virtual server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 96.0 GB of system memory. The defining characteristic of this instance is its massive bundled local storage, offering 70,866 GB of HDD capacity. It also provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Lacking a dedicated GPU, this server is designed for high-density storage workloads. It is highly cost-efficient for applications requiring massive data capacity on a budget, such as distributed file systems, large-scale log processing, and data warehousing.
